result.brief: 提出用想象 token 初始化扩散过程并蒸馏未来条件信息，实现单步动作生成的世界动作模型，用于自动驾驶与具身控制。
result.reason: World action model for driving/embodied control; contributes imagination-token action priors and future-conditioned distillation, but main contribution is policy action generation rather than video/multimodal world modeling.
